SQL_Inventory_DB.resolved_query: SELECT p.Product_ID, p.Product_Name, sp.Store_ID, sp.Stock_Quantity FROM Product p JOIN Store_Products sp ON p.Product_ID = sp.Product_ID ORDER BY sp.Stock_Quantity DESC

Postgres_Sales_DB.resolved_query: SELECT oi.product_id, oi.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN "Order" o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY oi.product_id, oi.order_id ORDER BY total_sales ASC
